title: Audio
description: Make music, sound effects and speech from text, in your browser. Nothing is uploaded to a server.
intro: Describe what you want to hear and it is made here, in your browser: music, sound effects, or a voice reading your text.
catalog.name: Audio
catalog.line: Makes music, sound effects and speech from text, with a player, a history and WAV downloads.
mode.label: What to make
prompt.placeholder.music: Lo-fi hip hop with mellow Rhodes chords, soft vinyl crackle and a warm upright bass, 80 BPM
prompt.placeholder.sfx: A heavy wooden door creaking open slowly, then slamming shut in a stone hallway
prompt.hint: Name the genre, the instruments, the mood and the tempo. The model learnt from descriptions in English.
prompt.hintSfx: Say what makes the sound, how and where. Effects work best short.
ideas.label: Ideas
seconds.label: Length
seed.label: Seed
seed.hint: The same description with the same seed gives the same result.
advanced.title: More settings
steps.label: Steps
steps.hint: The model is tuned for 8 steps. More steps take longer and do not always sound better.
text.label: Text to read
text.placeholder: Type or paste the text here. It can be long: it is read sentence by sentence.
voice.label: Voice
speed.label: Speed
action.download.music: Download the model ({size}) and make the music
action.download.sfx: Download the model ({size}) and make the sound
action.download.speech: Download the model ({size}) and read it aloud
need.webgpu: Music and effects need WebGPU with 16-bit numbers (shader-f16), and this browser does not offer them. Try a recent Chrome or Edge on a computer. The voice works here.
need.f16: The graphics card of this browser lacks 16-bit numbers (shader-f16), which music and effects need. The voice works here.
need.memory: This device has little memory for music and effects (the model takes about 1.8 GB). The voice works here.
player.label: Waveform of {name}. Click or use the arrow keys to move; space to play.
history.title: Your audio
history.empty: What you make shows up here and is kept only in this browser.
history.confirm: Press again to clear the history
history.note: The last {n} clips are kept in this browser. They never leave your device.
